== What changed on the image ==
[[File:CC-L-landocalrissian-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Lando Calrissian]]: The game text changes: “any starship” becomes “anything”; “starship is ''Falcon''” becomes “piloting Falcon”. The slip prints POWER 1, where the printed card and every later version print 2 (a mistake on the slip); “Falcon” is set upright. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Lando Calrissian” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
